Is there any book which gives information about amaliyath (black magic)and method of protection against it? 16624 views Q. Masturbation during Ramdan 3778 views Q. Asalamu alaykum. I understand in Islam that women and men shouldn't talk more than business. He asked me to delete the friends from my internet accounts who I didn't even talk to. Out of respect for him and because I knew that I would need to for marriage anyway I did this. But now he still has sisters who he works with or who are students that he advises on his account. He got angry with me when I asked him if he could do the same and delete them. He said that in Egypt men are allowed to but women can't (which is impossible anyway). answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 11336 Country: India Title: Asalam u Alaikum Warahmatullahi Wabarakatahoo We wanted to know about whether a "jin" can be burnt or not? If yes then please tell us Question: Asalam u Alaikum Warahmatullahi Wabarakatahoo We wanted to know about whether a "jin" can be burnt or not? If yes then please tell us Answer ID: 11336 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 443/307=L/1430) If they are not getting away by other means then it is lawful to burn them down. It is better to write in the ta?weez that if you will not go, you will be burnt i.e. they are alerted before being burnt that if they do not go away they will be burnt. Then also, if it is not obeying, one is allowed to burn then down. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
